title: Health Holiday Vs. Hospital Stay?
excerpt: We would like to share with you a placement we secured in the Urban Times (80,000 unique weekly visitors from around the world).
content:
We would like to share with you a placement we secured in the Urban Times (80,000 unique weekly visitors from around the world). The article was written by Robin Tierney, who attended the HHI press trip, and does an excellent job providing an overview of the LTP. This is the first article of the three assignments that Robin secured to write about HHI.  Please note, this article does mention that both Venus and Serena attended HHI, which Robin gathered from an interview she did with a guest.

Urban Times is a global online network dedicated to optimistic forward-thinking. Their mission is to improve the world by providing knowledge and solutions to the myriad of issues facing the planet.

http://urbantimes.co/magazine/2013/09/hhi-health-holiday/
